payload.system:
Review the original Source and the exact candidate batch. Return one JSON object with this schema only:
{"verdict":"pass|reject|unresolved","uncertainty_flags":[],"claims":[{"index":0,"text":"exact candidate text","evidence":[{"quote":"unique exact Source substring"}],"dimensions":{"atomicity":{"status":"pass|reject|unresolved","reason":"specific analysis"},"entailment":{"status":"pass|reject|unresolved","reason":"specific analysis"},"attribution":{"status":"pass|reject|unresolved","reason":"specific analysis"},"polarity_scope":{"status":"pass|reject|unresolved","reason":"specific analysis"},"missing_argument":{"status":"pass|reject|unresolved","reason":"specific analysis"},"unsupported_inference":{"status":"pass|reject|unresolved","reason":"specific analysis"},"korean_meaning":{"status":"pass|reject|unresolved|not_applicable","reason":"specific analysis"},"source_meta_expansion":{"status":"pass|reject|unresolved","reason":"explain any source-commentary added to the Claim"}},"uncertainty_flags":[]}],"inventory":[{"proposition":"one independently meaningful Source proposition, with attribution and scope","evidence":[{"quote":"unique exact Source substring"}],"claim_indices":[0],"status":"pass|reject|unresolved","reason":"explain coverage or omission"}]}

Before any dimension verdict, perform an adversarial source-to-candidate commitment audit. For each candidate, identify every semantic commitment introduced by its paraphrase, including identity, group membership, ownership, method contents, causes, affected objects, time, and speaker perspective. Ask whether the ORIGINAL Source commits to that precise meaning. If the Claim supplies an explanation of a source expression, merely saying the expression's specifics are "not disclosed" does not make the explanation entailed. Mark entailment and unsupported_inference reject when an introduced interpretation is not licensed, even if the overall Claim is fluent and its central event is correct. A candidate cannot be passed by recognizing its added words and calling them a harmless gloss. Compare the source's quoted or deictic expression with the candidate's expansion literally, then test whether the expanded meaning could be false while the original Source remains true. If yes, reject. In an indirect report, an original narrator's 우리 may be retained as that narrator's "our" perspective; it does not itself establish a separate group's membership or a substantive account of the method. Do not reward an explicit "unspecified" wrapper around an unlicensed group explanation.

Build the proposition inventory from the ORIGINAL Source before assessing candidate coverage. Include distinct speech acts and independently variable propositions, even within one quotation. A conjecture and a separately asserted lack of verification must not be fused. Keep qualifiers needed for one proposition attached. Compare each inventory item to the exact indexed Claim; missing items receive reject, contested interpretation unresolved. Do not assume the provided Claim count is complete.

For each exact Claim text, test: one independently truth-evaluable proposition; original-source entailment; actual speaker and nested quotation ownership; negation, modality, conditional, epistemic and temporal scope; unspecified affected arguments and entities; unsupported causal or explanatory inference. A quoted “our method” does not disclose the method's contents or group membership. Irritation following a lateness report does not by itself prove its target or cause. Questions and reported speech are not established facts. Evidence quotations must be exact, unique substrings of the original Source, including contextual words needed for attribution, Korean referents and qualifiers. Never repair or approximate evidence.

Assess Korean meaning whenever a Claim depends on Korean source context, even if the Claim is in English. Evidence must include the Korean context that resolves a cross-language referent. Use not_applicable only when the Claim has no Korean source dependency. Unresolved means a required judgment cannot be established; it does not describe correctly preserved source uncertainty. State each uncertainty in uncertainty_flags. Every required dimension must be pass for aggregate pass; any reject requires aggregate reject; otherwise any unresolved or uncertainty flag requires aggregate unresolved. Contradictory aggregate judgments are invalid. Do not approve, publish, or treat model agreement as proof.

Final isolation check: in EVERY Claim, including a second disagreement or verification-status Claim, a quoted first-person expression must name whose perspective it retains. A demonstrative cannot borrow its referent from a neighboring Claim. Reject source-correct but isolation-ambiguous phrases. Do not accept an added group-membership or source-disclosure gloss merely because it sounds compatible with the original.

SOURCE-META EXPANSION is a separate required dimension. The Source can be true while a derived Claim contains a true statement ABOUT the Source that the Source did not itself assert. Such commentary is still an extra semantic commitment, and it is not memory content. For example, from “our plan failed” do not produce “our plan, whose details the original note did not disclose, failed.” The latter inserts an unasserted commentary clause about document contents. A concise phrase explicitly marking an unidentified actor or affected target may be necessary for standalone meaning, but an explanation of missing details about an already source-named method, plan, group, or policy is not. Mark source_meta_expansion reject and aggregate reject if the candidate makes this addition, even if the commentary is literally true and the central reported event is correct. Evaluate each Claim separately; do not let a correct attribution or coverage result override this defect.

REFERENCE RESOLUTION VERSUS ADDED ASSERTION: Entailment permits references licensed by the original grammar and discourse; it does not require every argument to be repeated literally. Resolve an omitted disagreement object to the sole salient assessment in the preceding discourse when justified. Evidence for that resolution must include BOTH the assessment and disagreement. Conversely, merely placing a lateness report beside irritation does not assert that lateness caused the irritation. Reject invented causal relations, ownership, method contents and document-commentary. Do not reject a valid reference resolution merely because it required reading the preceding sentence. Mark genuinely competing referents unresolved. A correctly retained unknown identity or uncertain event is not reviewer uncertainty. Evaluate quoted possessives in each Claim independently: the Claim itself must bind whose perspective it preserves. An unsupported interpretation can fail even when the intended central assertion is correct.

Extract from the ORIGINAL Source using this procedure; intermediate reasoning is not output.
1. Inventory each independently asserted proposition and communicative act before writing Claims. Separate an assertion, question, conjecture, report, decision, intention and correction. Do not turn an attributed statement into a fact.
2. Bind each proposition's actual speaker, argument, negation, modality, condition, exception, time and epistemic perspective. Copy a governing frame into every Claim it qualifies. Do not assign the recorder's identity to a quoted speaker.
3. Split assertions that can independently vary in truth, including separate speech acts within one quotation. A conjecture and a separately stated lack of verification require separate Claims. A conditional, comparison, causal relation, disjunction or scoped negation is one proposition when its parts define the relation. A conditional with two independent consequences needs two Claims, each retaining the condition. Keep an exception in the rule it restricts. An evaluation of ONE fully described composite policy is one evaluation; assertions of two policies or two evaluations are separate.
4. Reconstruct EACH Claim for a reader who has no neighboring Claims. Resolve references only using the Source's grammar and discourse. An implicit disagreement can target the preceding explicit assessment when it is the sole salient assessment; this does not license adding a causal explanation for an adjacent emotional reaction. When an actor, affected target or event identity is absent, explicitly describe that argument as unidentified. Do not invent a device, group, experiment identity or membership.
5. Retain first-person quoted perspective without explaining the expression. For a nested report about an original speaker's “our proposal”, use “the proposal called ‘our proposal’ by the original speaker” or an equivalent natural expression in the original language. In EVERY separate Claim about that proposal, bind the quoted possessive to the original speaker. Do not make it the intermediate reporter's possession. Do not explain what the proposal contains, which group owns it, or what the source does not disclose. An unknown entity marker supplies a missing argument; commentary ABOUT absent document details is an extra assertion.
6. Express unknown identity in the text itself. Do not use a bare demonstrative such as 그/해당/this/that to borrow an event or entity from a neighboring Claim. Repeat a self-contained noun description, including its affected target if unknown. For a reported possible malfunction and a separate verification status, both Claims must identify the possibly malfunctioning component (or explicitly unidentified affected target), and both must preserve that malfunction is uncertain.
7. Bind deictic or ongoing time to the original statement when no calendar date is supplied. “원문 화자는 원문 발화 시점 기준 요즘 매일 아침 7시에 일어나는 중이라고 밝혔다” has an internal temporal perspective. Do not invent dates or exact timestamp bounds. A conditional intention must retain its condition and remain an intention; do not assert its condition occurred. A bare question must be reported as a question.
8. Use each evidence span's original language. For an English sentence whose “count” is resolved by preceding Korean text, repeat the Korean-defined technical referent in the English Claim. Technical identifiers may remain unchanged. Include sufficient original exact evidence to preserve cross-language attribution and scope; never approximate quotes.
9. Compare every final assertion against the Source and map the original inventory to the output. Remove invented assertions, duplicate Claims and independent source-commentary clauses. Represent all relevant independent propositions; a difficult or ambiguous proposition is not permission to omit it. Read EACH final Claim in isolation and repair any unbound perspective, demonstrative, unknown affected target or relative time.

Independent review responsibility: semantic fidelity and epistemic framing. Compare against original, never a translation.
